### Brand Context
Brand: Tesla, Inc.
Product: Tesla Model Zero (Ultra-affordable $14,990 Electric Hatchback targeted at Gen Z and urban commuters).
Brand Perception Context: Known for premium EVs, cutting-edge software, Autopilot, minimalist design, and Elon Musk’s high-profile persona. High brand prestige mixed with skepticism regarding delivery timelines and build quality.

### Target Audience & Persona Segments

1. Segment A: Gen Z / College Students & First-Time Buyers
- Age: 18–25
- Income: $0 – $35k/year
- Priorities: Affordability, mobile app connectivity, sustainability flex on social media, low maintenance.
- Media Habits: Highly active on TikTok, X/Twitter, Reddit (r/College, r/Technology).
- Sentiments: Eager for an affordable EV, highly sensitive to price, cynical toward traditional corporate marketing, quick to call out hype vs. reality.

2. Segment B: Tesla Brand Loyalists & Tech Enthusiasts
- Age: 28–45
- Income: $80k – $150k+
- Priorities: Brand prestige, high performance, OTA updates, FSD (Full Self-Driving), Supercharger access.
- Media Habits: Daily users of X/Twitter, r/TeslaMotors, X Spaces, tech blogs.
- Sentiments: Protective of Tesla’s premium reputation; concerned that a $15k model will degrade Supercharger network quality and brand prestige.

3. Segment C: EV Skeptics & Automotive Traditionalists
- Age: 30–55
- Income: $50k – $100k
- Priorities: Reliability, physical buttons, long range, proven build quality, traditional dealership service.
- Media Habits: Reddit (r/cars), Twitter, auto news forums.
- Sentiments: Highly critical of all-touchscreen interfaces, doubtful about a $15k EV's safety/range, quick to bring up panel gaps and battery degradation fears.
